messages.subject: R/qtl version 1.23-16
messages.body_plain:
A new version of R/qtl (1.23-16) has been released at its web site
(http://www.rqtl.org).  It should be on CRAN within a couple of days.

There were no major changes; this is mostly bug fixes, particularly to
fix a problem that was revealed in the pre-release version of R
(2.15.0).

See http://www.rqtl.org/STATUS.txt for a complete list of changes.

======================================================================
Please note:

In the next version of R/qtl, I may need to change the names of many
functions (particularly plot.geno, plot.missing, plot.pxg, and others
with similar names).  I hope to do this in a way that maintains
backward compatibility.  In the worst case, I will provide a separate
.R file that, when loaded with source(), will allow the use of the old
function names.
======================================================================

Karl Broman
kbr...@biostat.wisc.edu
